releaseNotes: Hardening release: the updater verifies an acknowledgement's identity (job, target version, payload) before Elmashad ever asks you to close Excel
New: disk space, staging and backup preflight before an update is armed; download retries on temporary network failures
New: automatic recovery if an update was interrupted mid-install - the previous working version restores itself at startup
New: failed updates can no longer leave the Updates window claiming Excel can close
New: failed or stale staged updates reconcile themselves at startup instead of looping
New: installer-driven updates can now run fully in place (shadow handoff); installer mode stays reserved for future releases
Foundation: mandatory-update policy plumbing and manifest signature preparation (inactive until signing keys exist)
